summary: Migration compiled cleanly but the WinUI 3 package cannot register because the manifest retained UWP out-of-process windows.backgroundTasks Extensions (EntryPoint without ActivatableClassId), causing 0x80080204. Every feature is dead. Single root cause, fully generalizable.
